newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Fa makes offer for Peace Hill.
newsitem.headline: Kong Fa makes offer for Peace Hill.

text.p: Kong Fa Holding Ltd said in a statement on Thursday it would make a general offer for Peace Hill Enterprise Group Ltd following the acquisition of an option to purchase a major stake in the listed company.
Kong Fa said it had exercised an option to purchase 67.22 percent of Peace Hill from parent Red Hill Co Ltd and was now launching a general cash offer at HK$4.05 per share.
Kong Fa values the 67.22 percent stake of Peace Hill at HK$174.61 million and the entire company at HK$260 million.
The offer price represents a 14.9 percent premium to the closing market price of Peace Hill at HK$3.525 on November 15, the day before trading in the shares was suspended.

Kong Fa is wholly-owned by Kong Look Sen and his family. Kong has more than 20 years experience in estate development, including infrastructure projects such as roads, sewerage and district cooling systems, in Malaysia.
The principal activities of Peace Hill consist of investment holding, property holding, securities broking and the provision of loan finance in Hong Kong and China.
Kong Fa intends to retain Peace Hill's stock market listing and the company will undertake steps following the general offer to ensure that 25 percent of the shares are held by the public.
